result.title: Query-Only Prompt-Agnostic Attacks on Visual In-Context Learning
result.summary: Visual In-Context Learning (VICL) enables promptable segmentation by conditioning RGB predictions on visual demonstrations, making it attractive for auto-labeling, but its robustness under query-only access and unknown deployment prompts remains underexplored. We study query-only, prompt-agnostic targeted attacks where the attacker observes only returned RGB outputs, without access to model internals or deployment prompts. Treating prompt-conditioned RGB rendering as a distinct attack surface, we introduce two appearance-space attacks: Color Hijack (CH) drives foreground colors toward the background to suppress visibility, while Task Hijack (TH) collapses instance-distinguishing colors toward a shared color assignment. To transfer across unseen prompts, we propose a Self-Prompt Surrogate (SPS) constructed from the clean query and its output. In a paired, matched-budget SegGPT comparison, SPS outperforms the Random-Prompt Surrogate (RPS), reducing CH instance foreground retention from 0.918 to 0.155 and TH palette-aware tolerance distance from 0.345 to 0.225. Across four VICL models on COCO and HierText, CH suppresses foregrounds across semantic-, instance-, and text-style outputs, while TH collapses instance colors under held-out deployment prompts. After palette-based decoding, TH also reduces the decoded instance count and mask retention while increasing instance merges. Finally, at 30% corruption, CH-corrupted annotations from a publicly accessible VICL-based auto-labeling pipeline reduce downstream YOLO-seg mAP50 from 0.761 to 0.281.

AI.brief_summary: 研究视觉上下文学习（VICL）可提示分割在仅能观察输出 RGB、且部署提示未知条件下的定向攻击，提出 Color Hijack 与 Task Hijack 两种外观空间攻击，并用由干净查询及其输出构造的自提示代理（SPS）提升跨未知提示迁移，在 SegGPT 等四个模型及自动标注下游任务上验证破坏效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接机制联系，但其把「提示条件输出渲染」当作攻击面、并在输出空间造成前景与实例颜色坍缩，可能可供核查视觉细节是否真正被使用而非旁路；自提示代理的构造思路或可启发在无内部访问时探测 conditioning 的作用。
